verdicts.reason: Both break the search-bar motif: the magnifier icon has slid out of its box and floats to the right, leaving an empty divided cell. The photo also floats in a white gutter that doesn't line up with the orange panel. In A, the panel and photo fill most of the height. B is the same layout with a thicker dead white strip under the panel and photo, which reads as cropped and unbalanced, so A is slightly less bad.
